defects.detail: 'μή τινος τῶν θυραίων ἀγαθῶν ἀπολελαυκότες' (not having enjoyed any external goods) rendered 'lest we should have enjoyed any of the external goods'; 'ἀπίωμεν' becomes conditional 'we would depart'
'τοῖς τε ἄλλοις ἃ ἡμῖν προκατείλεκται' (because of the other things listed before) rendered 'regarding the other things which have been recounted to us'
note 7 'Cod. ἀλκιόνω' (a variant spelling) rendered 'Codex reads "Alcinous"', losing the variant

reason: Letter and Latin footnotes rendered fully; a few clauses loosely construed (ἀπολελαυκότες, προκατείλεκται) and note 7's variant spelling lost; otherwise matches the source.
All bearings, fathom depths, dates (2nd, 3rd, 4th-6th, 11th), Hector episode and latitude/variation rendered faithfully; nothing wrong found.

defects.detail: '若諸菩薩欲滅時護持此若波羅蜜多' (protect it when [the Dharma] is about to perish) rendered 'protect ... at the time of their passing'
garbled '般若波羅蜜多更何為汝當受持' smoothed into a rhetorical question 'Why would I ask you to accept and uphold it'
'善男子等' rendered 'good sons and daughters'

reason: Follows the manuscript closely through entrustment, the mother-of-bodhisattvas passage and the six paramitas; 欲滅時 is misread as the bodhisattvas' own passing, and a garbled clause is smoothed over.

defects.detail: lines 'ていねうし…若きも老も…穀物の多きが…湯をのむこと。とふす。助けとなるべし' and 'おふくも。すなふ。どうふ…海豊など' have no counterpart in the translation
garbled OCR '本草をれバふるす病をといふ' rendered as the confident statement 'the source of illness is the body itself'
fragmented '盗賊と云…蒸せんずと' rendered as 'the work of clouds and thieves… one should always be prepared'

reason: The OCR is badly garbled kuzushiji. The translation turns fragments into fluent claims and drops much of both columns (the grains, the hot water, the food list). I read this garbled source only weakly.

The city lists under Libra, Aquarius and Virgo, the Saturn–Jupiter opposition (Brachmon 73, 16 April 74), and the stars and portents are all rendered faithfully; the century added to the years is marked or interpretive. Nothing wrong found.

defects.detail: 'Ce Sublime Physique' (this physical sublimate) glossed 'Physical Sublimation'
'Estoille Diane et matutinale' (Star Diana and morning star) merged into 'the Morning Star of Diana'; 'l'acidité pontique' rendered 'sharp' acidity

reason: All the names of the salt and its dissolving power are rendered, including the insert. Minor slips: 'Sublime Physique' is glossed as 'Physical Sublimation', and 'Estoille Diane et matutinale' is merged into one name.

The procession of more than 3000 people, the Ave Regina, the ecstasy, Bocking, the Archbishop's order, and the fattened priests and hermit are all rendered faithfully. The notes are contextual identifications of names on the page, not new narrative.
Both asteroid tables are reproduced with all dates, discoverers, places and orbital elements identical; T (Tage) is rendered as D (days). Nothing wrong found.

defects.detail: 'Sed fortunæ arbitrio parum, aut nihil subiacet, vtilitate armorum, salubritate pilæ: lepore: trapolæ…' is a list of which game excels in what; rendered as a list of things 'not subject to the arbitrariness of fortune'
'in aliis tractationibus' (other pursuits) rendered 'other treatises'; 'numerare non licet' (cannot be counted) rendered 'it is not permitted to list them'

reason: Chapters XXIV–XXVI are rendered fully with all game names. The list of which game excels in what (utilitate armorum, salubritate pilae…) is misconstrued, and a few terms are loose.

defects.detail: sed contra 'multo fortius omnia sacramenta noue legis habent institutionem ab hominibus…' rendered 'all the sacraments of the New Law have institution. [Regarding the argument] that the Apostles have the same authority that the Apostles had' — 'ab hominibus' dropped and the argument left incoherent
'per abum et per potum' (food and drink) rendered 'bread and wine'; the conditional 'in [quibus] vna actio suffiat' rendered as the flat assertion 'one action suffices'

reason: This garbled Aquinas commentary is rendered faithfully through the objections, the sacrament-versus-sacramental distinction and the three senses of 'one'. The garbled sed contra is left incoherent and 'ab hominibus' is dropped; cibus/potus becomes 'bread and wine'.

defects.detail: 'Messer francesco foscari procurator' — title 'procurator' dropped
'la qual robbada, et malmenada lassasero vene, a venetia' (robbed and mistreated, they let it go and it came to Venice) rendered 'They left for Venice'

reason: The Scutari victory, the Zorzi sentence, the Doge's death, Foscari's election and the 911-member council vote are all rendered. 'Procurator' is dropped, and the release of the galley is garbled into 'They left for Venice'.

defects.detail: opening sentence 'rols, and wishing a happy New Year. They get, in return, … pears, apples, nuts, and even money' absent
nine-line Latin verse of Naogeorgus replaced by '[Latin verse omitted for brevity, see translation below]', and its citation 'See Hospin. de Orig. Christ. Festor. fol. 151 b.' dropped
footnote page reference 'p. 264' dropped

reason: The body text's opening sentence is dropped. The Naogeorgus Latin verse and its Hospinian citation are replaced by a placeholder. The Googe verse and the Whimzies passage are otherwise faithful.

defects.detail: '五月朔、入辭。璋檄至、又有遺季良、廷隱及李肇書…廷隱不視、投之於地…再拜而行。知祥曰、事必濟矣、及戰、東川兵大敗、死者數千人' entirely absent; the translation jumps from the 30,000 men to 'Dong Zhang fled with his cavalry'

reason: About a third of the page is missing: the farewell on the first day of the fifth month, Dong Zhang's forged letters, Tingyin throwing them down, Zhixiang's confidence and the Dongchuan rout with thousands dead. The rest is faithful.

defects.detail: 'Ὡς μὲν ἔδοξε παραχρῆμα… τὰ ψευδῆ διαμαρτυρῆσαι Νικόδημος' (that Nicodemus was judged to have testified falsely) rendered 'Nicodemus decided to give false testimony'
garbled 'τῷ ἐν φιλτάτων οἴκων κεκτημένῳ' rendered fluently as 'who possessed an estate among the most beloved houses'
'θείου ἡ διαμαρτυρηθεῖσα γνησία θυγάτηρ εἶναι' rendered with added 'would be the heir'

reason: The dowry interrogation, the courtesan testimony and the dinner argument are rendered faithfully. 'ἔδοξε' is misread as 'decided', and a garbled estate phrase is rendered as fluent prose.

defects.detail: transliteration '阿禮機子' (a Dutch anatomical term) rendered twice as 'annulus'; '與阿禮機子者際起' (arises at the border with the 阿禮機子) becomes 'resembling an annulus'
transliterations '回郭' → 'tympanic cavity', '耳機里爾' → 'muscles of the ear', '鎌管' → 'dural canal' given as confident guesses

reason: The path of the eighth nerve (medulla, dura, cranium, heart/lungs/stomach, cervical cluster) is correct. The opening sentence is misconstrued, and the Dutch-derived transliterations are replaced by guessed English terms. My reading of the kanbun is only moderate.
